source.author: verg
source.text: Sacra Iovi Stygio, quae rite incepta paravi, perficere est animus, finemque imponere curis, Dardaniique rogum capitis permittere flammae.
source.text_original: Sacra Iovi Stygio, quae rite incepta paravi, / perficere est animus, finemque imponere curis, / Dardaniique rogum capitis permittere flammae.'
source.text_english: I intend to complete the rites to Stygian Jove, which I have properly begun, to put an end to my anxieties, and to commit the pyre of my Dardanian head to the flames.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
